implementation.targetScope: React 19 useVirtualizer/useWindowVirtualizer and useFlushSync for React-rendered single-lane Material React Table lists. Core re-exports and containerRef provided. Direct DOM style ownership, masonry, end-anchored feeds and iOS momentum correction excluded.

changes: Independent hook lifecycle over VPM core; one VPM dependency plus React/React DOM peers.
Notifications use committed callbacks and flush policy; abandoned renders cannot publish event handlers.
Suppress flushSync during adapter setup and suppress callbacks after disposal; clean StrictMode remounts.
React retains ownership of item and container styles; unsupported direct-DOM mode throws explicitly.

caller.name: material-react-table
caller.note: MRT enables virtualization through its options; current app call sites do not explicitly enable these options. This is an existing table-stack dependency, not a claim of active production virtualization.
